name: ashui-components
description: Reusable HXX controls for ashui, with CSS styling and keyboard and pointer behaviors.
releasenote: CodeEditor: zones (elements between two lines), change marks (bars in the gutter, deletion markers, minimap marks), find and replace, collaborative edits with peer cursors, compact gutter columns, SVG gutter icons and modifier-click navigation. CodeDiff: a line and word diff, inline and side by side, with folding, navigation, stage and revert hooks, icons you supply and inline line hints. A dialog panel built inside an if now opens with its dialog. Uses ashui 0.1.4.
